title: Ouagadougou municipal workers’ indefinite strike and reported mobilization
location: Maison des jeunes (reported; gathering date unclear)
organizer: Ouagadougou municipal workers; no single organizer identified in opened report
participants_original: The report says over 700 workers are on strike; that is workforce/strike participation, not a simultaneous public crowd count. A referenced mobilization at Maison des jeunes has no date or attendance count.
threshold_50_evidence: No dated public event/site count establishes 50.

start_date.summary: LeFaso reports an indefinite strike began 5 November.

end_date.summary: Strike described as continuing as of 17 November; end not established.

location.summary: Workers in Ouagadougou; a Maison des jeunes mobilization is mentioned without precise event date.

scope.summary: Municipal employee labor action in Ouagadougou; possible press event also surfaced only in search snippet.

organizer.summary: Municipal workers are described collectively; organizing body not established.

participants_original.summary: “Over 700” refers to workers on strike, not an event-site count.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No dated public event with a simultaneous attendance count established.

state_response.summary: No accommodation/coercion response to a specific qualifying gathering documented.

notes: Work stoppage alone is insufficient; the report’s unspecified mobilization at Maison des jeunes and search-only Nov23 press conference need event-specific evidence.
open_questions: Identify any dated public gathering and actual site attendance; do not use strike workforce as threshold; obtain a new independent source for the 23 November press conference without retrying its timed-out exact URL if unnecessary.
